name: Hindsight Docs Sync
description: Downloads documentation repositories into a local snapshot and syncs it into a Hindsight knowledge bank.

faq.question: Start exits immediately
faq.answer: The app is a one-shot CLI. Start runs Download and Sync once, then exits. Run the Download and Sync actions when you want one operation only; Sync alone retries an existing snapshot.

faq.question: A sync failed partway
faq.answer: Run Sync again. The snapshot is already on disk, so no download is needed, and Hindsight skips documents it already ingested. Only the remaining documents are uploaded.

faq.question: Where are the downloaded documents
faq.answer: In this app's user-data folder: documents for the published snapshot, .cache for Git clones and converted files, and sources.json for a local source list. The CLI repository ships no documentation.

faq.question: How do I change the built-in source list
faq.answer: The built-in catalogue comes from this marketplace app and is written to user-data/builtin-sources.json at install and update. Add or override entries in user-data/sources.json, or disable ids in the Disabled sources setting. Point Built-in sources file at an empty value to use only local sources.

faq.question: How are API rate limits handled
faq.answer: Requests are paced at four per second by default. A 429 or 5xx response is retried with exponential backoff and jitter, and a Retry-After header is honoured up to 60 seconds. Failed batches are retried one document at a time.

settings.label: Hindsight API URL
settings.help: Address of the Hindsight API. No trailing slash.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: Sent as HINDSIGHT_API_KEY. Leave empty when the Hindsight app runs without authentication.

settings.label: Knowledge bank
settings.help: Bank that receives the documents. Created when it does not exist.

settings.label: Built-in sources file
settings.help: Catalogue shipped by the marketplace. Empty disables built-in sources.

settings.label: Local sources file
settings.help: Optional JSON list merged over the built-in list. Same id replaces the built-in entry.

settings.label: Disabled sources
settings.help: Comma-separated ids to skip, for example php,symfony-7-4.

settings.label: Requests per second
settings.help: API pacing. 0 disables pacing; 429 responses still back off.
